address: Twr y Felin Hotel, Ffordd Caerfai, St Davids, SA62 6QT, United Kingdom
bio: Originally built in 1806 as a working windmill, the Twr y Felin Hotel features contemporary artwork and is decorated in an understated, modern style. Its restaurant, named after the Welsh word for 'taste’, offers appealing menus which showcase seasonal Pembrokeshire produce from John Dory to lamb in pared-back, modern dishes. The friendly team run the place with pride, enhancing the overall experience....
